nodes.label: Icon Box Execution
nodes.description: SVG-in-PNG icon depicting a 44x44 rounded rectangle box with a rabbit/speed symbol inside, used to represent fast order execution in the trading platform UI. The box background uses a CSS variable fill with low opacity, and the icon includes a vector path forming the execution symbol.
